name: ecom Smart-Ex 02 DZ1
statusNote: Distributors list it as end of life, with the Smart-Ex 03 as its replacement.
summary: The ecom Smart-Ex 02 DZ1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) smartphone from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 1 in North America. It runs Android 11, with a user-replaceable battery. It has been discontinued; the ecom Smart-Ex 03 DZ1 replaces it.

otherSchemes: INMETRO version exists (cert no. not captured)

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib op is IIC T4 Gb IP64 / II 2D Ex ib op is IIIC T120°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ib op is IIC T4 Gb IP64 / Ex ib op is IIIC T120°C Db

certification.northAmerica: SGS: Cl I, II, III Div 1 Groups A-G T4 IP64; Cl I Zn 1 AEx ib op is IIC T4 Gb; Zn 21 AEx ib op is IIIC T120°C Db
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ib) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Use only Ex-BP S02 battery packs; charge battery pack outside hazardous area (per DZ2 safety instructions - confirm DZ1 manual)

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
Among the lightest Zone 1 smartphones we list, at 380 g in use
limitations: Discontinued; the ecom Smart-Ex 03 DZ1 replaces it
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
